name: ANSI/IEEE fuse-switch symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for fuse-switch, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The fuse-switch form identifies a switching assembly involving a documented fuse element. The exact construction and operating arrangement belong to the product reference; drafting should retain both switching and protective meanings.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Keep the operating handle reference separate from the fuse-link tag.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A fuse-switch is not merely a differently drawn circuit breaker.
